name: Storzen QuickView for WooCommerce
author: WebTend

sections.description:
Storzen QuickView for WooCommerce is a lightweight and fast product quick view plugin that allows customers to instantly preview products in a popup modal without leaving the shop page.

Instead of navigating back and forth between product and shop pages, users can quickly view product details, images, and add items to cart in a smooth AJAX-powered experience.

This improves WooCommerce store usability, reduces page reloads, and increases conversion rates.Perfect for modern eCommerce stores that want a faster, cleaner, and more engaging shopping experience.

Lightweight and fast WooCommerce quick view plugin that works with any WooCommerce theme.

View Documentation

Why Use WooCommerce Quick View?

WooCommerce stores often lose customers due to slow navigation between product pages.

WooCommerce Quick View solves this by enabling:

  • Instant product preview popup (no page reload)
  • AJAX-powered quick view for WooCommerce products
  • Faster shopping experience with reduced friction
  • Improved user engagement and product exploration
  • Mobile-friendly product modal experience
  • Lightweight performance with minimal load impact

Key Features

Instant Product Preview Popup
A smooth modal opens on click — displaying product image, title, price, rating, short description, and Add to Cart button — all without a page reload.

Quick View Button on Shop & Category Pages
Automatically adds a customizable “Quick View” button to every product card on your shop, category, and archive pages.

Works with Any WooCommerce Theme
Built to be fully compatible with all standard WooCommerce themes right out of the box — no extra configuration needed.

Full Design Control — No CSS Required
Use the built-in settings panel to customize:

  • Button background color & text color
  • Button border radius
  • Modal popup width
  • Button label text & position (on image / below title / below price)

Choose Where the Button Appears
Control which pages show the Quick View button — shop page, category pages, or both.

Mobile Responsive
The popup is fully responsive and optimized for phones, tablets, and desktops.

Lightweight & Performance-Friendly
CSS and JavaScript load only on pages where the Quick View button is displayed — zero bloat on the rest of your site.

Keyboard Accessible & Screen Reader Friendly
Focus trap, Escape key support, and ARIA labels are included for full accessibility compliance.

Perfect For

  • Fashion & clothing stores with size/color variants
  • Electronics & gadget shops with detailed specs
  • Large WooCommerce catalogs where browsing speed matters
  • Any store focused on improving conversion rate optimization (CRO)

How It Works

  1. User hovers or clicks on a product
  2. Quick view button opens a popup modal
  3. Product details load instantly via AJAX
  4. User can view images, price, and description
  5. Add to cart without leaving the shop page

That’s it. No shortcodes. No page builder required.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to Storzen Quick View to configure button text, position, display options, and design tokens.
  5. Visit your shop page — the Quick View button will appear automatically on product cards.
sections.faq:
Where can I find the documentation?

Full documentation is available at https://storzen.webtend.net/storzen-quickview-doc.html

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active for Storzen Quick View to work.

Does it work with variable products (size, color, etc.)?

The free version displays a “View Product” link for variable products. Full variation selection inside the popup — choosing size, color, and other attributes — is available in Storzen Pro.

Will it slow down my store?

No. Storzen Quick View only loads its CSS and JavaScript on shop, category, and product pages where the button is shown.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes. The popup is fully responsive and optimized for all screen sizes.

Which themes are supported?

It works with most well-coded WooCommerce themes. If you experience a styling conflict, please open a support ticket and we will help you resolve it.

Can I change the button text and position?

Yes. Go to Storzen QuickView in your WordPress admin. You can change the button text, set the button position (on image, below title, or below price), and choose which pages to show it on.

Can I customise the button colours and modal size?

Yes — use the Design tab in the settings page. Colour pickers let you choose button background and text colours; number inputs control the border radius and modal width. All customisation is done through structured controls — no CSS editing required.

Is the modal keyboard accessible?

Yes. The modal traps focus, supports Escape key to close, and includes ARIA labels for screen reader compatibility.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Renamed plugin to “Storzen QuickView for WooCommerce” across all strings, admin menu, and UI header.
  • Fixed version constant mismatch (STORZEN_QV_VERSION was ‘1.1.0’, now correctly ‘1.1.1’).
  • Added uninstall.php for WordPress.org compliance — removes plugin options on uninstall when opted in.
  • Performance optimized.

1.1.0

  • Replaced arbitrary Custom CSS textarea with structured Design controls (button colour pickers, border-radius, modal width) to comply with WordPress.org plugin guidelines.
  • Custom CSS is now generated programmatically from validated design tokens — no freeform code is stored or injected.
  • Existing installs are automatically migrated: the custom_css option is removed and new design-token defaults are written on plugin activation.
  • Added wp-color-picker integration in the admin for colour fields.
  • Added live preview swatch in the Design panel.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Quick View button on shop, category, and related product loops.
  • AJAX-powered modal with product image, title, price, rating, excerpt, and Add to Cart.
  • Settings page: button text, position, and display page control.
  • Mobile responsive modal.
  • Keyboard accessible (focus trap, Escape to close, ARIA labels).
  • Compatible with WooCommerce 8.x and WordPress 6.x.
